messages:
tess: Heads-up: deploy scheduled for Tue 17:30 UTC (maintenance quiet window 17:15-18:00). I'm the handoff owner. Please ack rollback criteria and owners. Link to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploy-watchtower

alex: Ack. I'll watch canary for the first 10 minutes, then hand to @maria.

maria: Quick question — what's our hard rollback trigger? Error budget burn or p99 latency?

jonathan: From the runbook (TL;DR): rollback if either: >5% client error rate sustained for 3m OR p99 inference latency >600ms for 3m. Also rollback on tiered degradations we can't mitigate within 5m.

alex: Added: if embeddings quality regressions detected by evals pipeline (score drop >7%), treat as immediate rollback. devex-bot will post evals summary to #eng-ml.

tess: Owners: @alex (canary watch), @maria (rollback exec), @jonathan (infra/DB toggles), @tess (postmortem & comms). Who will run the actual rollback commands?

maria: I will run rollback CLI unless I'm paged. Command snippet in runbook:```
# rollback to previous deployment
redwoodctl deploy rollback --service watchtower --to-revision prev
# or kubectl
kubectl rollout undo deploy/watchtower --to-revision=3
```

jonathan: DB migration note: we have non-destructive toggle. If rollback needed, flip feature-flag:```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $FF_TOKEN" https://flags.internal/feature/watchtower-off -d '{"enabled":false}'
```
This should short-circuit new code paths before full rollback if quick mitigation wanted.

alex: Smoke checklist (canary):
- basic auth flow + token validation
- bulk infer small batch (5 req/s for 1m)
- KV cache warm and hit-rate >70%
- memory use under 85% for GPUs
- logs show no OOMs or "kernel launch failed"

maria: I'll run those smoke steps and post results in this thread.

sre-bot: Reminder: deploy window has 15m quiet period. If any external jobs are scheduled during that window, they will be paused automatically.

tess: Monitoring: @alex will watch Kibana dashboard "watchtower/canary" and perf-alerts. If alerts fire, ping @maria and @jonathan. Use #pager to escalate.

alex: quick ping — who has access to surge capacity if we need to fire up extra nodes?

jonathan: I built a burst pool; I can trigger it: `infra-burst start --pool watchtower-burst` but it takes ~120s to warm. Prefer rollback if user-facing errors.

maria: Prep done: smoke run locally (see gist) and infra knobs verified. I will post timestamps and small logs here when I start smoke.

tess: Communication plan: if rollback executed, I will post to #release-updates with summary + incident lead. If canary stable after 20m, we proceed to full rollout at 17:55 UTC.

alex: ACK :thumbsup:

maria: Starting canary smoke at 17:31 UTC (will post pass/fail).

maria: PASS @17:34 UTC — all smoke checks green. KV hit 82%, p99 310ms, errors 0.4%. Handing off to @alex for 10m steady watch.

alex: steady watch: +10m green, no alerts. Proceed with staged ramp to 25% at 17:45, 50% at 17:50.

tess: Noted. If anything looks off during ramp, we use feature-flag short-circuit first, rollback if that doesn't help. Everyone on-call please stay reachable for the next 45m.

devex-bot: Deployed canary at 17:30 UTC by tess. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploy-watchtower. Eval job queued: will post results in #eng-ml.

jonathan: If we end up rolling back, please paste the CLI output and any db toggle calls here so we can trace.

maria: Will do. Thanks all.

alex: final ack at 17:55 UTC — ramp completed, metrics steady. Closing handoff. :tada:
